integrity: Analytic proof with a positive one-crossing/stop-loss argument; accompanying high-precision tests corroborate finite cases but are not an infinite-dimensional certificate. Publication priority remains subject to comparison with older radial approximation and stochastic-order literature.
scientific_limitations: Only real affine L2-orthogonal projection with uniform volume on concentric spherical annuli in dimensions at least two, and its separately defined surface-measure limit. No eccentric holes, nonradial weights or degree-above-one statements.
title: Strict hole monotonicity and exact affine-projection norms on spherical annuli
